headline: Leaks, geysers and blockages, sorted.
intro: Fast, tidy plumbing for homes and small businesses. Send a photo of the problem and get a straight answer.
service_1_desc: Dripping taps, leaking pipes and running toilets found and fixed before they push up the water bill.
service_2_desc: Repairs, replacements and new installations, with a clear quote and no mess left behind.
service_3_desc: Kitchens, bathrooms and outside drains cleared properly so they stay clear.
service_4_desc: New taps, basins, toilets and showers fitted neatly and to standard.
step_1_desc: WhatsApp a picture or short video of the problem and your area.
step_2_desc: We'll tell you what's likely wrong and what it should cost before anyone arrives.
step_3_desc: We arrive when we say, fix it properly and clean up after ourselves.
about_text: You shouldn't have to chase a plumber. We answer, we show up when we say we will, and we explain what we're doing in plain language.
faq_1_a: Message or call and we'll tell you how soon we can get to you.
faq_2_a: Yes. A photo usually gets you a ballpark, and we confirm the price on site before starting.
faq_3_a: Lenasia and the surrounding suburbs. Ask if you're unsure.
contact_title: Got a leak? Let's fix it.
